_README: Titles for the documents whose own first page does not give one.
The pipeline records a title per document in stage0_documents.json, and for
14 of the 22 it is the real one. For the rest it picked up a masthead, an
advertisement or a keyword list, because that is what the top of those pages
holds. A citation carrying the wrong title is worse than one carrying a
filename, so those are corrected here, each read off the document itself.
A file with no entry falls back to its recorded title, and a document with
no usable title falls back to its filename: adding to the corpus never
requires editing this file, it only lets you improve what a reader sees.
